definitions.short: to veil from sight, i.e. conceal (literally or figuratively)
definitions.usage: × any ways, blind, dissembler, hide (self), secret (thing).
definitions.full: H5956. alam I. [ עָלַם ] verb conceal (Late Hebrew id. , derived species); — Qal Participle pass עֲלֻמֵנוּ Psa 90:8 as substantive our secret , i.e. hidden sin (|| עֲוֺנֹת ). Niph`al Perfect be concealed , of wisdom, 3 feminine singular מֵעֵינֵי נֶעֶלְמָה Job 28:21 ; of a fact or condition, נֶעְלַם 2Chr 9:2 , ׳וְנ consecutive Lev 5:2-3 , 4 (all with מִן person), ׳וְנ מֵעֵינֵי 4:13 ; Num 5:13 (all P); Participle 1 נֶעְלָם concealed , with הָיָה in periphrastic conjugation 1Kin 10:3 ( מִן person); absolute כָּלנֶֿעְלָם Eccl 12:14 . 2 feminine singular נַעֲלָמָה תְּהִי Nahum 3:11 mayest thou become obscured (as to the senses; figurative for swoon ), but very doubtful, read perhaps נעלפה ? [Dr]. 3 plural נַעֲלָמִים Psa 26:4 those who conceal themselves , i.e. their thoughts; dissemblers (|| שָׁוְא מְתֵי ). Hiph`il Perfect 3masculine singular הֶעְלִים 2Kin 4:27 ; 3 plural הֶעְלִימוּ Ezek 22:26 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תַּעְלִים Psa 10:1 , תַּעְלֵם Lam 3:56 ; 3 masculine plural יַעְלִימוּ Lev 20:4 , etc.; Infinitive absolute הַעְלֵם 20:4 ; Participle מַעְלִים Job 42:3 ; Prov 28:27 ; — conceal, hide , with מִן person 2Kin 4:27 (|| לִי הִגִּיד לֹא ); usually hide the eyes from ( מִן ), i.e. disregard Isa 1:15 ; Ezek 22:26 , יַע ׳הַעְלֵם ׳וגו Lev 20:4 , מִן omitted Prov 28:27 ; hide the eyes by ( ב ) a bribe 1Sam 12:3 (i.e. pervert justice, but see עַיִן 3d ); hide (cover) the ear Lam 3:56 (turn a deaf ear); hide (obscure) counsel ( עֵצָה ) Job 42:3 ; ׳תַּע לָמָה Psa 10:1 why dost thou [ ׳י ] hide , that is, thine eyes (so most), or practise concealment (= hide thyself)? Hithpa`el Perfect 2masculine singular consecutive מֵהֶם וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ Deut 22:1 , 4 and thou hide thyself completely from them (utterly neglect to aid), so Infinitive construct ( מֵהֶם omitted) לְהִתְעַלֵּם 22:3 ; so also Imperfect with תִּתְעַלַּם מִן, Psa 55:2 , תִּתְעַלָּ֑ם Isa 58:7 ; once literal יִתְעַלֶּםשָֿׁ֑לֶג Job 6:16 wherein snow hides itself .
